name: siftmemory
description: Claude Code bridge for SiftMemory resumable reasoning memory.

siftmemory.autoStartDaemon.description: Automatically start the SiftMemory daemon if installed but not running.

siftmemory.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for daemon startup.

siftmemory.activeHeartbeatIntervalMs.description: Heartbeat interval while Claude session is active.

siftmemory.idleHeartbeatIntervalMs.description: Heartbeat interval while Claude session is idle.

siftmemory.maxHeartbeatFailures.description: Consecutive heartbeat failures before marking daemon down.

siftmemory.maxRestartAttempts.description: Maximum daemon restart attempts per Claude session.

siftmemory.healthCacheTtlMs.description: How long a successful health check can be reused.

siftmemory.notifyCoreMissing.description: Show notification when SiftMemory core is not installed.

siftmemory.notifyDaemonDown.description: Show notification when daemon is unavailable.

siftmemory.disableWhenCoreMissing.description: Disable SiftMemory operations when core binaries are missing.

siftmemory.releaseUrl.description: Release URL shown when core is missing.

siftmemory.injectOnSessionStart.description: Inject minimal resume context at session start.

siftmemory.injectOnUserPrompt.description: Inject task-specific resume context when user submits a prompt.

siftmemory.captureToolEvents.description: Capture Claude tool use as SiftMemory events.

siftmemory.captureFailures.description: Capture failed tool use as events.

siftmemory.recordOutcomesOnStop.description: Record session outcomes when Claude stops.

siftmemory.strictHookFailures.description: If true, selected hooks may fail closed. MVP default is fail open.
